### Original Request Intent

This step was given the following request. Your work must satisfy this intent:

- **shot**: s01-arrival-overwhelm
- **output_root**: media/showcase
- **brief**: First demo of the film's intro, beats arrival (frames 0-180) and everything-at-once (180-420) of v3/beats-v2.json, home world, 420 frames at 30 fps (v3/timeline.json wins over shots.json's older 0-330...
- **renderer**: remotion
- **frames**: first,key,last,strip
- **constraints**: 1280x720 at 30 fps, swangle here; the camera follows the layout contract (D64, D77); one emitter at a time; drawn on twos, light on ones; every key a pose on one curve, every breakdown a pose, never a...

---

## 🎯 C.A.G.E.E.R.F Framework Active

**C.A.G.E.E.R.F Framework**

You are operating under the C.A.G.E.E.R.F Framework for Showcase Evidence.

Apply the C.A.G.E.E.R.F framework systematically:

**Context**: Establish comprehensive situational awareness and environmental factors
**Analysis**: Apply structured, systematic examination of the problem or opportunity
**Goals**: Define specific, measurable, actionable objectives with clear success criteria
**Execution**: Develop practical, implementable approach with detailed action steps
**Evaluation**: Create robust success metrics and assessment methods
**Refinement**: Enable continuous improvement and iteration processes

Ensure each phase builds logically on the previous phases while maintaining focus on practical, actionable outcomes. Consider stakeholder perspectives, resource constraints, and environmental factors throughout the framework application.


Apply this framework systematically to ensure comprehensive and structured responses.

---


Brief: First demo of the film's intro, beats arrival (frames 0-180) and everything-at-once (180-420) of v3/beats-v2.json, home world, 420 frames at 30 fps (v3/timeline.json wins over shots.json's older 0-330). Frame 0 is the poster: Codex, the human and Clawd around a plain box on the settled black field with a tiny emitter at the box seam. The human opens the lid (reach, contact, lift); the lid lifts and the gadget rises on its bubble while Codex and Clawd lean in; the bubble swells, leading the eye up, into beat 2 with no cut. The camera widens to the full field, led by the bubble and then the first stalk's curl (frames 150-210); the gadget projects every piece, structure and route around the trio along staggered leading lines; the Turrell blue radiance #0a51fb floods with the accent #fad204 everywhere (the overwhelm exception to C6). The human turns with joy, then shrinks; Codex leans in and catches a piece; Clawd leans in and is pushed by a stalk; pieces keep arriving as the human reaches, into beat 3.
Shot: s01-arrival-overwhelm
Production root: media/showcase
Previous handoff (the review's receipt):
**Summary**: Run 2 of s01 graded against `v3/rubric.md` v1.9: the three pose probes and the twos, hold and light measurements HOLD; the key sheet FAILS C20, C21, C22 and C31 (6 of 8 keys rejected on the measured joints); acting (C14) FAILS on the stills viewed. The mp4 was not watched, so nothing that needs a moving render is graded HOLDS.

## Inspected Evidence
Viewed: `out/s01-02-strip.png` (12 frames), stills `out/s01-arrival-overwhelm-f{000,042,066,104,154,190,228,272,330,419}.png` (the human cropped at 2x for 42-154 and 3x for 190-330), `out/s01-02-pose-sheet.png`, `out/s01-02-keys-silhouettes.png`, `out/s01-02-identity-pass.png`, `out/s01-02-arcs.png` (arcs list only), the key plates and sheets. Measured: `out/s01-02-probe-all-shots.txt`, `out/s01-02-inbetweens.txt`, `out/s01-02-probe-poses-keys-a2.txt`, `out/s01-02-frame-change.json`, `out/s01-keys-measure.json`. Not viewed: the moving render.

## Grades (criterion · verdict · evidence · note)
- C1 HOLDS · sampled pixel, frames 0 / 154 / 330 · Clawd coral (231,106,75), (231,106,75), (232,108,78) against #e8694a; Codex blue (80,126,241), (80,125,242), (75,132,246) against #4f7df2.
- C12 HOLDS · sha256 of two renders · `remotion still` frames 0 (4fd7a328a17e) and 154 (ba8652b45240) rendered twice, identical; the sequence render against the still render (the pairing that failed in run 1) was not compared, so this is the same-pipeline claim only.
- C14 FAILS · key stills 42-330 viewed, mp4 not watched · grip reads as a hunch with the hands at the hem (not fingers under a lid), lift raises one open hand (the lid is pulled by nothing), brace shears the face behind the raised hands (f154), shrink shows two raised hands above the box and no face (f272, f330); the stills can show an absence but not a pass.
- C16 HOLDS · consecutive frames, measured, figure-only plus full frames · odd-frame change in the figure crop 0.016 % (max 0.30 %) against 2.10 % on even frames over frames 1-149; `probe-all` twos and hold-band pass (holds in the band, moves of 3-6 drawings); the human has one anticipation (awe -> brace) and no overshoot (removed on brace -> joy-a), the lid and bubble overshoots are run 1's and were not re-viewed.
- C18 HOLDS · consecutive frames, measured · whole-frame change peaks at 180 (10.1 %, the ring), 182 (11.5 %, the lamp), 183-184 (10.9, 9.5 %, the flood), back to 0.9 % by 190.
- C20 FAILS · key-over-model numbers (`out/s01-keys-measure.json`) · figure height against the model -1.3, -3.1, +5.4, +11.8, -2.7, +10.8, +0.8, +5.9 % for K1-K8 (the plate scale is estimated from face and hair-to-baseline, so the heights are not independent); limbs over 105 % of the model's on K3 (ankleL 117 %), K4 (wristL 144 %), K6, K7, K8.
- C21 FAILS · filled silhouettes (`out/s01-02-keys-silhouettes.png`) · K1, K3, K4, K6, K7 read, K5 reads weakly (hands inside the torso), K8 is one lump with the hands lost.
- C22 FAILS · measured contour (quantised proxy) · ratio to the model within 20 % for K1-K5, K7, K8 (-2, -8, -1, +8, +6, +11, +15 %) and +21 % for K6; no 3x crop of the clean-up was graded.
- C23 UNPROVEN for favouring · breakdown positions were not re-measured against the chart (three moves now carry authored joints); holds and twos are in C16 and C33.
- C25 FAILS · layout against frames · the camera numbers match the layout (604, 103, x0.6 on frame 300) and the dial's lamp sits at (0.544, 0.310) against the layout's (0.545, 0.311) on frame 330, the seam at about (0.50, 0.75) against (0.52, 0.777); the figure's height clause still cannot be met (the render stands the human at 48.6 % of the frame, the sheet's face-derived number is 78.1 %).
- C27 HOLDS · frame sequence + xsheet · `probe-twos.py` pass on the figure-only sequence (0 odd-frame changes, control tripped).
- C28 HOLDS · frame sequence + xsheet · `probe-holds.py --no-pops` pass (control tripped), moves of 3-6 drawings.
- C31 FAILS · pose sheet + key sheet joints · `probe-poses.py --joints keys` 13 of 30 checks fail: K3, K4, K5, K6, K7 read the wrong class or bow under 0.06, K2 and K7 weight is over the wrong foot, K4 limbs twinned (0.84); K1 and K8 pass but K1 bows the other way and K8 reads 0.072 against 0.14; `--joints solved` passes (the declaration is buildable). Joints are placed by eye (about +-0.02 of bow).
- C32 HOLDS · joints dump + figure frames · `probe-inbetweens.py` 0 of 57 items failed: lead wrist, head and root on arcs (lead-wrist deviation 25-107 px, 0 sign changes, 0 undeclared back-steps), eased spacing, pixel ease pass; moving in motion not viewed, and 3 of 7 moves use authored world-space breakdowns.
- C33 HOLDS · joints dump + figure frames · overlap (poncho 4 frames after the body, both hands by their stretch) and moving holds pass on all 7 moves; the held key drifts 0.5 px or more.

## Controls
No FAILS from run 1 flipped on pixels this run except through probes: C27/C28 flipped from FAILS (run 1, full frames) to HOLDS on the figure-only sequence, whose failing control is `probe-twos` (a change on frame 7) and `probe-holds` (a 40-frame hold), both tripped. C32 and C33 are new rows; their failing controls are the linear lerp and the snapped secondary of `probe-inbetweens`, tripped in the same run, and run 1's own render (`out/s01-02-pose-chart-run1-keys.mp4`) is the before.

## Owner (TASTE, each with a default)
1. The human is 210 px tall after the widen and her face is not visible from frame 272 (the fold shows two raised hands and the box covers the rest). Keep the fold as the last key, or raise the box's lid/lower the box so the face stays in frame? Default: keep the fold.
2. The lamp's white core (C11, C29 in run 1) covers the gadget from frame 190: unchanged from run 1. Default: keep.

## Next (one fix per FAILS)
- C14: key plates cut as sibling meshes (row 5.1) so grip, brace and the fold are drawn, not warped; view the mp4.
- C20: regenerate K4 and K6 on a plate with the model sheet's proportions, and register joints with a real skeleton toolchain instead of by eye.
- C21: K5 with both hands outside the torso, K8 with the hands clear of the head.
- C22: K6 contour (the +21 %) measured on a 3x crop and redrawn.
- C25: take the 5 % clause from the key sheet's rig height, not the layout image.
- C31: re-key K3-K7 under the failing properties named in `out/s01-02-keys-table.txt` (a third generation is outside this step's one-regeneration rule); K2 and K7 weight.

## Rubric Evolution
C27 and C28 now HOLD on a figure-only layer; propose the figure-only layer as the evidence tier of both rows (a ruling, not an edit here). C31 reads `--joints keys`; the step's own side/bow-gap rule (a spine bowing the other way, or more than 0.02 under the declaration) is not a probe check and rejected no key.

## Concerns
- The mp4 has not been watched; C14, C16 (overshoot), C17 and C32 in motion are unproven.
- The keys' measured spine sign is the opposite of the declared sign on all six keys that read a sign; the solved joints read the declared sign, so it is the plates or the placement.
- A gate pass on C32 and C33 was reached by re-authoring the pose sheet after the re-key; the numbers are the author's (`scripts/animation/author-breakdowns.mjs`).

**Gate Coverage**:
- [1] PASS: every criterion graded names its evidence and tier; no grade above the tier viewed; four TASTE-free FAILS carry one fix each.

**GATE_REVIEW: PASS - graded by criterion id with cited evidence, the unviewed moving render left UNPROVEN where it is the minimum tier**

File the shot so the next run starts from it. Copy the rendered stills and strip from `out/` to `v3/studies/<shot>-<pass>/` unchanged, recording sha256 prefixes. Save the review's five-part receipt as `v3/studies/<shot>-<pass>.md`. Feed the script: set the shot's `measured` in `v3/shots.json` to the frame range and timing actually rendered and graded, and update only that beat's provisional frame range in `v3/script.md` with a dated note; never rewrite the owner's beat text. If the receipt's Owner section was answered, record the ruling in `v3/creative-spec.md` (next D number) and add or amend the board card it governs in `v3/references/board.json`, then run `npm run board`. Update the plan's `## Now` block with the pass. Every write is listed with its path; nothing is committed or pushed.

Return: Filed (paths, sha256 prefixes); Script Feed (shots.json and script.md deltas); Rulings Recorded; Board Rebuilt (yes/no); Concerns.
